newsitem.title: USA: Rowdy airline passenger held for mental check.
newsitem.headline: Rowdy airline passenger held for mental check.

text.p: A man who threatened the crew of a KLM Royal Dutch Airlines flight from Amsterdam to Minneapolis and had to be restrained in handcuffs was ordered Tuesday to undergo a competency hearing.
U.S. Federal Magistrate J. Earl Cudd ordered that Osamar Shadeed, 21, be held pending the examination and said he would set another date for a court appearance later.
According to an FBI report on the incident made available at the hearing, Shadeed became abusive during the Jan. 2 flight and ripped a gold chain from the neck of an 11-year-old boy.
The report quoted him as telling the crew after he was restrained: "I'll kill you. My Moslem friends will kill you. Let me go and you will live."
Shadeed's nationality was not diclosed. Agents said they believed he boarded the flight in the Persian Gulf.
He was arrested on federal aircraft threat charges after the plane landed.
